intent.job_to_be_done: Restate the user's goals, underlying problem, observable success check, and up to 3 high-leverage assumptions or open forks in plain paraphrased words, then hard-stop for confirmation before editing files or acting.
target_users: Engineers aligning with an AI coding agent on ambiguous or high-stakes tasks
Teams enforcing a cheap pre-execution understanding check before code generation
inputs: User brief, feature request, bug symptom, or /in-your-own-words invocation
Optional referenced repository files, error logs, or specs inspected read-only
outputs: Concise four-part playback (Goal, Problem, Success Check, Assumptions & Open Forks) plus a single drift-check stop
exclusions: Compiling fresh-session execution prompts (matt-implement-prompt) or /goal directives (goal-meta-skill)
Prose polishing, copywriting, translation, or article summarization (write, renhua)
Well-specified routine edits unless explicitly invoked

contracts.output_contract: Four-part paraphrased playback (Goal, Problem, Success Check, up to 3 Assumptions/Open Forks) ending in a single drift-check question and hard stop, optionally audited to zero errors by scripts/check_playback.py.
contracts.authority_boundary: Playback-not-Execution: strictly read-only during alignment; never edits files, generates code diffs, runs mutating commands, commits, or proceeds on 'reversible' work without user confirmation.
